aids.description_en: Contributory social insurance pension. Average monthly benefit ₩650,000 for retired workers (2025). Maximum monthly benefit approximately ₩1,000,000 for full contribution history. Contribution rate 9% of salary (4.5% employer + 4.5% employee).

Minimum living standard guarantee for households below the standard median income threshold. 2025 reference amount: ₩713,102/month for 1-person household (30% of median income). Covers living expenses, housing, medical, education, and self-sufficiency components.
aids.organisme: Ministry of Health and Welfare / Local governments

aids.description_en: Non-contributory pension for low-to-middle income elderly aged 65+. 2025 maximum monthly amount: ₩342,510 for eligible recipients in lower 70% income bracket. Automatically reduced for NPS recipients.

Wage replacement benefit at 60% of prior daily average wage. Maximum ₩66,000/day (2025). Duration: 120–270 days depending on contribution history and age. Must be involuntarily unemployed, registered at Employment Center, and actively seeking work.
aids.organisme: Ministry of Employment and Labor (MOEL) / Korea Employment Information Service

aids.description_en: Universal monthly cash allowance of ₩100,000 per child aged 0–7 (under 8 years). No income or asset testing — paid to all Korean resident children regardless of family income. Approximately 3.7 million children benefit.
aids.organisme: Ministry of Health and Welfare / Local governments

aids.description_en: Universal mandatory health insurance covering 97% of population. Low-income Medical Aid recipients pay 0 premium. Standard subscribers pay income-proportionate premiums with significant subsidy for low-income households. Covers 80%+ of medical costs for inpatient care.

Wage replacement for parental leave: 80% of ordinary wage (min ₩70,000, max ₩1,500,000/month) for first 3 months, then 50% (max ₩1,200,000/month) for months 4–12. Available to both parents. Special daddy quota: 100% replacement for first month of second parent's leave.

Monthly benefit for severely disabled persons aged 18+. Basic payment: ₩342,510/month (2025) for those in lower 70% income bracket. Additional amount varies. Replaces former disability allowance for Grade 1-2 (severe) disability holders.

Rental assistance for low-income households. 2024 maximum: ₩330,000/month for 1-person household in Seoul (Type I area); ₩255,000 in metropolitan areas; ₩201,000 in other cities. Also includes home repair grants up to ₩24.5 million.
aids.organisme: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport / Korea Land and Housing Corporation (LH)

aids.description_en: Annual education subsidy for students from low-income households within Basic Livelihood Security system. 2025 amounts: elementary school ₩487,000/year, middle school ₩589,000/year, high school ₩654,000/year plus school fees. No income deduction applied.
aids.organisme: Ministry of Education / Local education offices
